name: ha-treemap-card
description: A treemap card for Home Assistant dashboards

scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm knip && pnpm test:run
scripts.deploy:ha: pnpm build && cp dist/treemap-card.js ~/dockers/homeassistant/config/www/ && echo p12KIM3 | sudo -S sed -i "s/treemap-card\.js?v=[^\"']*/treemap-card.js?v=$(date +%s)/" ~/dockers/homeassistant/config/.storage/lovelace_resources && cd ~/dockers/homeassistant && echo p12KIM3 | sudo -S docker compose restart homeassistant

simple-git-hooks.commit-msg: perl -i -ne 'next if /^Co-Authored-By:/i; next if /^Co-Author:/i; next if /^Generated with \[Claude/; next if /^via \[Happy\]/; print' $1 && perl -i -0pe 's/\n+$/\n/' $1

author: Ondrej Machala
